persona_notes: Premium private transport. Avoid generic taxi/shuttle vibes. The goal is to evoke trust, comfort, and the epic scale of the New Zealand landscape. Design uses generous spacing, asymmetrical grids for destinations, and a warm, grounded color palette.

weights.headings: font-light for elegance, font-medium for emphasis (avoid default bold)

grid_modes.destinations: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8 (Use Tetris Grid logic for asymmetry)
grid_modes.services: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 (Control Room Variant - uniform height via h-full)

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for standard cards, rounded-2xl for floating images, rounded-none for edge-to-edge sections
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content. Center-align only for short section headers if it improves rhythm.

hero.style: Full viewport height (min-h-[80vh] or min-h-[600px]). Use 'hero_background' image with a left-to-right gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1C2B23]/95 via-[#1C2B23]/60 to-transparent) to ensure perfect text contrast. Text must be aligned left.
hero.cta: Primary button in accent color (Terracotta #D97746) to drive bookings, secondary in glass/white.

header.style: Sticky top, Crystal Glass effect (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-black/5). Navigation links visible on desktop, no hamburger on desktop.

marquee_testimonials.style: Editorial Ribbon style. Pale background (F4F2EE), dark text, massive gaps (gap-32), Outfit font, smooth slow drift using react-fast-marquee.

forms.style: Shadcn based. Stripped down Vercel look. Inputs with bg-white, border-[#EAE5DB], focus:border-[#2D5A43] focus:ring-[#2D5A43]/20. Use Shadcn Calendar/Popover for Date selection.

buttons.style: px-6 py-3 rounded-lg transition-all duration-200. Hover must be explicitly defined.

hero_background.description: Black premium luxury SUV on scenic NZ mountain road

chauffeur_fleet.placement: Fleet / Chauffeur Service Section (About Us or Services)

van_interior.description: Premium luxury van interior looking at mountains

destination_mountains.placement: Destinations Bento Grid - The Hero block (col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2)

destination_snow.placement: Destinations Bento Grid - The Tall block (col-span-4 row-span-2)

destination_hobbiton.placement: Destinations Bento Grid - The Square block (col-span-4 row-span-1)

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='booking-submit-btn', data-testid='nav-services-link').
